Rebate summary types and functions for adding transactions and generating rebate reports.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_pack_rebate_sum_t` state used by pack to collect rebate data from microblocks and bundles, then turn that data into one or more `fd_pack_rebate_t` reports. It declares the data structures that store rebate totals, per-writer rebate entries, and the internal map used while transactions are processed. The file also provides the interface for creating, joining, clearing, adding transaction rebate data with [`fd_pack_rebate_sum_add_txn`](<#fd_pack_rebate_sum_add_txn>), and exporting a report with [`fd_pack_rebate_sum_report`](<#fd_pack_rebate_sum_report>). Static size checks and footprint helpers are included to enforce memory layout limits for the rebate summary and report objects.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_pack_rebate_sum_new`
- `fd_pack_rebate_sum_add_txn`
- `fd_pack_rebate_sum_report`
- `fd_pack_rebate_sum_clear`
